name: Estado geral da central
command: echo '=== CUSTOMROM ESTADO GERAL ==='; date; echo; echo '--- MODELO ---'; getprop ro.product.model; echo '--- FABRICANTE ---'; getprop ro.product.manufacturer; echo '--- HARDWARE ---'; getprop ro.hardware; echo '--- PLATAFORMA ---'; getprop ro.board.platform; echo '--- BUILD ---'; getprop ro.build.display.id; echo '--- ANDROID ---'; getprop ro.build.version.release; echo '--- ABI ---'; getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist; echo; echo '--- MEMORIA ---'; cat /proc/meminfo; echo; echo '--- SWAP ---'; cat /proc/swaps; echo; echo '--- ARMAZENAMENTO ---'; df -h

name: Memória, swap e ZRAM
command: echo '=== MEMORIA ==='; cat /proc/meminfo; echo; echo '=== SWAP ==='; cat /proc/swaps; echo; echo '=== ZRAM ==='; ls -l /sys/block/zram* 2>/dev/null; for z in /sys/block/zram*/mm_stat; do [ -f "$z" ] && { echo "--- $z ---"; cat "$z"; }; done

name: Processos mais pesados
command: echo '=== TOP ==='; top -b -n 1 -m 30 2>/dev/null || top -n 1; echo; echo '=== CPUINFO DUMPSYS ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== PS ==='; ps -A

name: Rede e ADB
command: echo '=== REDE ==='; ip addr 2>/dev/null; echo; ip route 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== WIFI ==='; dumpsys wifi 2>/dev/null | head -n 120; echo; echo '=== ADB PROPS ==='; getprop | grep -i adb 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== PORTAS ==='; ss -lnt 2>/dev/null || netstat -lnt 2>/dev/null

name: Pacotes e serviços
command: echo '=== PACOTES ==='; pm list packages -f; echo; echo '=== DESATIVADOS ==='; pm list packages -d; echo; echo '=== SERVICOS ==='; dumpsys activity services 2>/dev/null

name: Logcat curto
command: logcat -d -v threadtime -t 1200

name: Snapshot completo para análise
command: echo '=== IDENTIDADE ==='; getprop; echo; echo '=== MEMORIA ==='; cat /proc/meminfo; echo; cat /proc/swaps; echo; echo '=== CPU ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== TOP ==='; top -b -n 1 -m 40 2>/dev/null || top -n 1; echo; echo '=== DISCO ==='; df -h; echo; echo '=== PACOTES ==='; pm list packages -f; echo; echo '=== PROCESSOS ==='; ps -A; echo; echo '=== POWER ==='; dumpsys power 2>/dev/null | head -n 160

name: Temperatura e thermal
command: echo '=== THERMAL SERVICE ==='; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== THERMAL SYSFS ==='; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do [ -r "$z/type" ] && { printf '%s: ' "$(cat $z/type 2>/dev/null)"; cat $z/temp 2>/dev/null; }; done | head -n 120

name: Energia, bateria e wake
command: echo '=== BATTERY ==='; dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== POWER ==='; dumpsys power 2>/dev/null | head -n 220; echo; echo '=== DEVICE IDLE ==='; dumpsys deviceidle 2>/dev/null | head -n 160

name: Armazenamento e partições
command: echo '=== DF ==='; df -h; echo; echo '=== MOUNTS ==='; mount | head -n 160; echo; echo '=== STORAGE ==='; dumpsys diskstats 2>/dev/null; dumpsys mount 2>/dev/null | head -n 180

name: Fluidez e renderização
command: echo '=== SURFACEFLINGER ==='; dumpsys SurfaceFlinger 2>/dev/null | head -n 180; echo; echo '=== GFXINFO ==='; dumpsys gfxinfo 2>/dev/null | head -n 260; echo; echo '=== WINDOW ==='; dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | head -n 180

name: Tela e aplicativo em primeiro plano
command: echo '=== TOP ACTIVITY ==='; dumpsys activity activities 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity|ResumedActivity' | head -n 20; echo; echo '=== WINDOW FOCUS ==='; dumpsys window 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 20; echo; echo '=== DISPLAY ==='; dumpsys display 2>/dev/null | head -n 100

name: Aplicativos instalados pelo usuário
command: pm list packages -3 -f -u

name: Aplicativos desativados
command: pm list packages -d -f -u

name: Configuração de tela
command: echo '=== WM SIZE ==='; wm size; echo '=== WM DENSITY ==='; wm density; echo '=== BRILHO ==='; settings get system screen_brightness; settings get system screen_brightness_mode; echo '=== ROTACAO ==='; settings get system accelerometer_rotation; settings get system user_rotation; echo '=== TIMEOUT ==='; settings get system screen_off_timeout

name: Estado das animações Android
command: echo 'window_animation_scale='$(settings get global window_animation_scale); echo 'transition_animation_scale='$(settings get global transition_animation_scale); echo 'animator_duration_scale='$(settings get global animator_duration_scale)

name: Áudio e rotas ativas
command: echo '=== AUDIO ==='; dumpsys audio 2>/dev/null | head -n 260; echo; echo '=== MEDIA SESSION ==='; dumpsys media_session 2>/dev/null | head -n 160

name: Bluetooth e dispositivos
command: echo '=== BLUETOOTH ==='; dumpsys bluetooth_manager 2>/dev/null | head -n 260; echo; echo '=== BT PROPS ==='; getprop | grep -i bluetooth | head -n 80

name: Serviços iniciados no boot
command: echo '=== BOOT COMPLETED RECEIVERS ==='; dumpsys package 2>/dev/null | grep -B2 -A6 'android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED' | head -n 320; echo; echo '=== RUNNING SERVICES ==='; dumpsys activity services 2>/dev/null | head -n 320

name: Configurações técnicas atuais
command: echo '=== GLOBAL SELECTED ==='; settings get global adb_enabled; settings get global development_settings_enabled; settings get global stay_on_while_plugged_in; settings get global window_animation_scale; settings get global transition_animation_scale; settings get global animator_duration_scale; echo; echo '=== SYSTEM SELECTED ==='; settings get system accelerometer_rotation; settings get system user_rotation; settings get system screen_off_timeout

name: Desativar animações do sistema
command: settings put global window_animation_scale 0; settings put global transition_animation_scale 0; settings put global animator_duration_scale 0; echo 'Animações definidas para 0x'

name: Restaurar animações em 1x
command: settings put global window_animation_scale 1; settings put global transition_animation_scale 1; settings put global animator_duration_scale 1; echo 'Animações restauradas para 1x'

name: Ativar rotação automática
command: settings put system accelerometer_rotation 1; echo 'Rotação automática ativada'

name: Desativar rotação automática
command: settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0; echo 'Rotação automática desativada'

name: Manter tela ligada durante carga
command: svc power stayon true; echo 'Tela configurada para permanecer ligada durante alimentação'

name: Restaurar comportamento normal da tela
command: svc power stayon false; echo 'Comportamento normal de suspensão restaurado'

name: Inspecionar hierarquia da tela atual
command: uiautomator dump /data/local/tmp/customrom_ui.xml >/dev/null 2>&1; cat /data/local/tmp/customrom_ui.xml 2>/dev/null; rm -f /data/local/tmp/customrom_ui.xml

name: Por que a central está lenta?
command: echo '=== MEMORIA RESUMO ==='; grep -E 'MemTotal|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree' /proc/meminfo; echo; echo '=== CPU TOP ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null | head -n 80; echo; echo '=== TOP PROCESSOS ==='; top -b -n 1 -m 25 2>/dev/null || top -n 1; echo; echo '=== DISCO ==='; df -h; echo; echo '=== THERMAL ==='; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null | head -n 100

name: Wakelocks e alarmes que acordam a central
command: echo '=== WAKE LOCKS ==='; dumpsys power 2>/dev/null | grep -i -A80 -E 'Wake Locks|mWakefulness|mHolding' | head -n 180; echo; echo '=== ALARMS ==='; dumpsys alarm 2>/dev/null | head -n 320

name: Jobs agendados em segundo plano
command: echo '=== JOBSCHEDULER ==='; dumpsys jobscheduler 2>/dev/null | head -n 420

name: Histórico de crashes e ANRs
command: echo '=== CRASH BUFFER ==='; logcat -b crash -d -v threadtime -t 400 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== DROPBOX CRASH ==='; dumpsys dropbox --print system_app_crash 2>/dev/null | tail -n 260; echo; echo '=== DROPBOX ANR ==='; dumpsys dropbox --print system_app_anr 2>/dev/null | tail -n 260

name: Temas e overlays ativos
command: echo '=== OVERLAYS ==='; cmd overlay list --user 0 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== FABRICATED ==='; cmd overlay list 2>/dev/null | head -n 260

name: Teclas, touch e dispositivos de entrada
command: echo '=== INPUT ==='; dumpsys input 2>/dev/null | head -n 420; echo; echo '=== INPUT METHOD ==='; dumpsys input_method 2>/dev/null | head -n 220

name: Launcher e aplicativos padrão
command: echo '=== HOME RESOLVIDA ==='; cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== PREFERRED ==='; dumpsys package preferred-activities 2>/dev/null | head -n 320; echo; echo '=== ROLE ==='; dumpsys role 2>/dev/null | head -n 180

name: DNS, proxy e conectividade
command: echo '=== PROXY ==='; settings get global http_proxy; echo '=== PRIVATE DNS ==='; settings get global private_dns_mode; settings get global private_dns_specifier; echo; echo '=== CONNECTIVITY ==='; dumpsys connectivity 2>/dev/null | head -n 360

name: Acessibilidade e teclado ativos
command: echo '=== ACCESSIBILITY ENABLED ==='; settings get secure accessibility_enabled; settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services; echo; echo '=== IME ==='; settings get secure default_input_method; ime list -s 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== NOTIFICATION LISTENERS ==='; settings get secure enabled_notification_listeners

name: USB, acessórios e funções atuais
command: echo '=== USB ==='; dumpsys usb 2>/dev/null | head -n 360; echo; echo '=== USB PROPS ==='; getprop | grep -i -E 'usb|mtp' | head -n 100

name: SELinux, Verified Boot e integridade
command: echo '=== SELINUX ==='; getenforce 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== VERIFIED BOOT ==='; getprop ro.boot.verifiedbootstate; getprop ro.boot.flash.locked; getprop ro.boot.vbmeta.device_state; getprop ro.boot.veritymode; echo; echo '=== SECURITY PATCH ==='; getprop ro.build.version.security_patch

name: Abrir Configurações Android na TayTech
command: am start -a android.settings.SETTINGS; echo 'Tela de Configurações solicitada'

name: Abrir configurações de Wi‑Fi na TayTech
command: am start -a android.settings.WIFI_SETTINGS; echo 'Tela de Wi-Fi solicitada'

name: Abrir configurações de Bluetooth na TayTech
command: am start -a android.settings.BLUETOOTH_SETTINGS; echo 'Tela de Bluetooth solicitada'

name: Abrir lista de aplicativos do Android
command: am start -a android.settings.APPLICATION_SETTINGS; echo 'Tela de aplicativos solicitada'

name: Ir para a Home da TayTech
command: input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME; echo 'Comando Home enviado'

name: Voltar uma tela na TayTech
command: input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK; echo 'Comando Voltar enviado'

name: Serviços persistentes e foreground
command: echo '=== FOREGROUND / SERVICES ==='; dumpsys activity services 2>/dev/null | grep -E -i -B2 -A8 'foreground|startRequested=true|isForeground=true|packageName=' | head -n 700

name: Permissões especiais e AppOps
command: echo '=== APPOPS ==='; dumpsys appops 2>/dev/null | head -n 900

name: Consumo por apps desde a carga
command: echo '=== BATTERYSTATS ==='; dumpsys batterystats --charged 2>/dev/null | head -n 1000

name: Aplicativos usados recentemente
command: echo '=== USAGESTATS ==='; dumpsys usagestats 2>/dev/null | head -n 900

name: Exceções de economia de energia
command: echo '=== DEVICEIDLE WHITELIST ==='; cmd deviceidle whitelist 2>/dev/null; echo; dumpsys deviceidle 2>/dev/null | grep -E -i -A120 'Whitelist|mPowerSaveWhitelistApps|mExceptIdleWhitelistApps' | head -n 360

name: Launchers disponíveis na central
command: echo '=== HOME CANDIDATES ==='; cmd package query-activities --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== HOME RESOLVIDO ==='; cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME 2>/dev/null

name: WebView e provider atual
command: echo '=== WEBVIEW ==='; dumpsys webviewupdate 2>/dev/null | head -n 420

name: Localização e GNSS
command: echo '=== LOCATION ==='; dumpsys location 2>/dev/null | head -n 800

name: Sensores e clientes ativos
command: echo '=== SENSOR SERVICE ==='; dumpsys sensorservice 2>/dev/null | head -n 800

name: Câmeras e clientes ativos
command: echo '=== CAMERA SERVICE ==='; dumpsys media.camera 2>/dev/null | head -n 650

name: Prioridade e pressão dos processos
command: echo '=== ACTIVITY PROCESSES ==='; dumpsys activity processes 2>/dev/null | head -n 1000

name: Tráfego e estatísticas de rede
command: echo '=== NETSTATS ==='; dumpsys netstats 2>/dev/null | head -n 900

name: Políticas e administradores do dispositivo
command: echo '=== DEVICE POLICY ==='; dumpsys device_policy 2>/dev/null | head -n 700

name: Notificações, listeners e canais
command: echo '=== NOTIFICATION ==='; dumpsys notification 2>/dev/null | head -n 900

name: Origem de instalação dos aplicativos
command: echo '=== PACKAGES + INSTALLER ==='; pm list packages -f -i -u 2>/dev/null

name: Limites de processos em segundo plano
command: echo 'background_process_limit='$(settings get global background_process_limit); echo 'cached_apps_freezer='$(settings get global cached_apps_freezer); echo 'activity_manager_constants='$(settings get global activity_manager_constants)

name: Ethernet e rede cabeada
command: echo '=== ETHERNET ==='; dumpsys ethernet 2>/dev/null | head -n 500; echo; ip link 2>/dev/null

name: Horário, timezone e sincronização
command: echo '=== DATE ==='; date; echo 'timezone='$(getprop persist.sys.timezone); echo 'auto_time='$(settings get global auto_time); echo 'auto_time_zone='$(settings get global auto_time_zone)

name: Por que o Spotify está lento?
command: echo '=== SPOTIFY PACKAGE ==='; dumpsys package com.spotify.music 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|minSdk=|targetSdk=|primaryCpuAbi=|secondaryCpuAbi=|codePath=|flags=' | head -n 100; echo; echo '=== SYSTEM COMPAT ==='; echo system_release=$(getprop ro.build.version.release); echo system_sdk=$(getprop ro.build.version.sdk); echo system_security_patch=$(getprop ro.build.version.security_patch); echo system_abi=$(getprop ro.product.cpu.abi); echo system_abilist=$(getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist); echo system_abilist64=$(getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist64); echo; echo '=== SPOTIFY PROCESS ==='; echo spotify_pid=$(pidof com.spotify.music 2>/dev/null); dumpsys meminfo com.spotify.music 2>/dev/null | head -n 180; echo; echo '=== SYSTEM MEMORY ==='; grep -E 'MemTotal|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree' /proc/meminfo; echo; cat /proc/swaps 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '=== CPU RELEVANT ==='; dumpsys cpuinfo 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'com.spotify.music|com.google.android.gms|system_server|surfaceflinger|audioserver' | head -n 100; echo; echo '=== SPOTIFY GFX ==='; dumpsys gfxinfo com.spotify.music 2>/dev/null | head -n 240; echo; echo '=== AUDIO ==='; dumpsys audio 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'spotify|music|AudioTrack|focus|A2DP|active' | head -n 240; echo; echo '=== MEDIA SESSION ==='; dumpsys media_session 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E -A8 -B4 'spotify|com.spotify.music' | head -n 180; echo; echo '=== EXIT INFO ==='; dumpsys activity exit-info com.spotify.music 2>/dev/null | head -n 180; echo; echo '=== THERMAL ==='; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null | head -n 100; echo; echo '=== RECENT LOGS ==='; PID=$(pidof com.spotify.music 2>/dev/null); PID=${PID%% *}; if [ -n "$PID" ]; then logcat -d -v threadtime -t 1600 2>/dev/null | grep -E " $PID |com\.spotify\.music|m\.spotify\.musi|AudioFlinger|AudioTrack|MediaCodec|CCodec|lmkd|lowmemorykiller|Choreographer|BluetoothA2dp" | tail -n 500; else logcat -d -v threadtime -t 1200 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'com\.spotify\.music|m\.spotify\.musi|Spotify' | tail -n 300; fi
